## Who I Am

I am a results-oriented Master's student in Ireland specializing in **Business Analytics and AI-driven business solutions**. My work sits at the intersection of international trade and advanced analytics — translating complex data into strategic insights that inform real decisions.

My professional perspective is built upon a foundation in International Business and Trade, further enriched by practical experience in high-volume commercial environments across Mexico. During my time in customer-facing and operational roles, I developed an acute understanding of how supply chain dynamics, pricing fluctuations, and seasonal trends directly influence consumer behaviour. This firsthand observation of market variables served as the catalyst for my transition into advanced analytics.

I am currently refining my technical proficiency in Python, SQL, and Business Intelligence tools to translate complex datasets into actionable business intelligence. My goal is to combine my international business background with rigorous quantitative analysis to help organisations bridge the gap between global strategy and localised operational impact.

::: {.callout-note}

## What I Do

I apply data science techniques — particularly **Natural Language Processing (NLP)** and **Machine Learning** — to business problems. My recent work has focused on financial sentiment analysis, LLM-enabled content pipelines, and supply chain digitalisation. I am most energised when a technical project connects back to a concrete strategic question.

My MSc programme has focused on applying analytics directly to business problems:

- **Applied Business Analytics** — statistical methods and analytical frameworks for business decision-making

## Professional Background

My professional journey has spanned retail, consulting, and the financial services sector:

- **General Manager / Social Media** — Florería y Regalos Martha, Mexico (Feb–May 2025)
  Managed inventory and logistics for a retail environment; developed commercial awareness through direct customer interaction and social media management.

- **Sales / Professional Staff** — Coco Bongo Show and Disco, Playa del Carmen, Mexico (2015–2016)
  Applied problem-solving and communication in a fast-paced international tourism hub. Gained strong commercial awareness through high-volume customer interaction.

- **Consultancy Support (Intern)** — Consultoría Especializada de Sonora, Mexico (Jan–Jun 2015)
  Assisted in consultancy and quality management projects, gaining foundational experience in business operations.

Each of these roles reinforced my conviction that data — when properly interpreted — is the most powerful tool a business has for understanding its customers and improving its operations.
